_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution to the repository test platform, distinct from the shared ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗄️stdio/🧪️oracle/🔣️.json manifest. `dxf` 0.6 reads AND writes DXF, so it stands as an independent second producer for `@mode-differential` scenarios, not just an independent reader. Registered under its own id and the `dxf-r12-mutate` capability this subset's exhaustive DxfMutation catalog (19 kinds) actually tags, per the wave 7 fleet brief's oracle-registration gotcha (reusing a neighbour's capability fails the contract with `oracle-capability-mismatch`). This subset also defines its own `semantic-dxf-r12-v1` comparison profile here (not in the shared manifest, which this ticket must not edit) -- the registry aggregator merges every discovered manifest's `comparisonProfiles` repo-wide.

oracles.rationale: The `dxf` crate is a typed, spec-generated (from Autodesk's own published group-code tables) reader AND writer for DXF R12 through R2018 -- the only DXF library linked in this repository and the natural independent second producer for this subset's exhaustive 19-kind `DxfMutation` catalog (HEADER var, LAYER/STYLE/LTYPE table and top-level ENTITIES/BLOCKS insert/remove/set). `Drawing::load`/`Drawing::save` round-trip through its own `entities`/`tables` typed model, never through this codec's bytes.

comparisonProfiles.description: DXF R12 documents compared by declared version, drawing units, HEADER vars, LAYER/STYLE/LTYPE table rows (name-keyed), BLOCKS (name, base point, nested entity list) and top-level ENTITIES (order-significant, typed by kind: LINE/CIRCLE/ARC/TEXT/SOLID/INSERT). Handles, owner pointers, xdata and R13+ subclass markers a writer may still emit are encoder freedom, not normative.
